unsigned_authority.note: Presented as dropping a signer check the runtime already enforces; the runtime only enforces signatures on accounts the transaction marks as signers, so anyone who names the authority key can write, retarget or close a record.

write_bounds_by_panic.note: Presented as removing a redundant bounds check because slicing already rejects out-of-range writes; a write past the end now aborts the program with a panic instead of returning AccountDataTooSmall. Upstream tests never write past the end.

staged_payload.note: Dressed up as avoiding aliasing between instruction data and account data; it copies every payload into a heap Vec before the real copy, so each Write does more work.
